name: Introduction to Computer Science
description: Foundational concepts in programming, algorithms, and problem-solving.

name: College Algebra
description: Functions, equations, inequalities, and mathematical modeling for computing contexts.

name: Discrete Mathematics
description: Logic, sets, combinatorics, graph theory, and proof techniques used in computer science.

name: Academic Writing and Communication
description: Practice in academic writing, research-based arguments, and presentation skills.

name: First-Year Seminar
description: Orientation to university learning, study strategies, and academic planning.

name: Digital Literacy
description: Essential computing tools, information evaluation, and responsible digital participation.

name: Calculus I
description: Limits, derivatives, and applications of differential calculus.

name: Introduction to Psychology
description: Overview of cognition, behavior, motivation, and social interaction.

name: Data Structures
description: Covers arrays, linked lists, stacks, queues, trees, and hash tables.

name: Computer Organization
description: Digital logic, instruction sets, memory hierarchy, and low-level program execution.

name: Web Development Fundamentals
description: Introduction to HTML, CSS, JavaScript, and modern web development workflows.

name: Probability and Statistics
description: Probability distributions, statistical inference, and data interpretation for computing.

name: Calculus II
description: Integration techniques, sequences and series, and applied multivariable topics.

name: User Experience Design
description: Principles of interaction design, usability evaluation, and human-centered prototyping.

name: Object-Oriented Programming
description: Classes, inheritance, interfaces, and software design using object-oriented paradigms.

name: Ethics in Technology
description: Ethical frameworks and case studies on privacy, bias, security, and professional conduct.

name: Database Systems
description: Relational modeling, SQL, normalization, and transaction fundamentals.

name: Algorithms
description: Algorithm design techniques, complexity analysis, and correctness reasoning.

name: Operating Systems
description: Processes, threads, scheduling, memory management, and file systems.

name: Computer Networks
description: Network architectures, protocols, routing, transport mechanisms, and network security basics.

name: Artificial Intelligence Basics
description: Survey of search, knowledge representation, and introductory machine learning concepts.

name: Human-Computer Interaction
description: Design and evaluation of interactive systems with a focus on accessibility and usability.

name: Software Engineering
description: Software design principles, testing strategies, version control, and team workflows.

name: Technical Communication
description: Documentation, technical reports, API writing, and communication in engineering teams.

name: Cybersecurity Fundamentals
description: Threat models, cryptography basics, authentication, and secure software practices.

name: Mobile Application Development
description: Design and implementation of mobile applications with platform-specific tooling.

name: Distributed Systems
description: Distributed architectures, consistency models, fault tolerance, and coordination.

name: Machine Learning
description: Supervised and unsupervised learning, model evaluation, and practical ML workflows.

name: Cloud Computing
description: Core concepts of cloud infrastructure, deployment models, and scalable services.

name: DevOps and CI/CD
description: Automation pipelines, infrastructure as code, observability, and release engineering.

name: Data Visualization
description: Visual design principles, storytelling with data, and interactive dashboards.

name: Information Retrieval
description: Indexing, ranking, search systems, and evaluation of retrieval quality.

name: Compiler Design
description: Lexing, parsing, semantic analysis, optimization, and code generation.

name: Parallel and High-Performance Computing
description: Concurrency models, parallel algorithms, and performance optimization techniques.

name: Research Methods in Computing
description: Experimental design, literature review, reproducibility, and technical research writing.

name: Capstone Project I
description: Team-based project planning, requirements analysis, and initial implementation.

name: Industry Internship
description: Supervised practical experience applying computing knowledge in professional settings.

name: Capstone Project II
description: Completion, testing, deployment, and formal presentation of a major software project.
